mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate over the past 12 months signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE above 3.5% triggers a labor cost inflation signal, leading to reduced corporate profitability expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in UNRATE rises above 3.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and decline in INDPRO (supply) creates a demand-supply imbalance, driving upward pressure on asset prices and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 20-day returns in co-movement are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO above 103.0 signals robust supply-side growth, stimulating demand and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in INDPRO increases above 103.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.5% signals monetary easing, reducing policy tightness and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, 60-day forward returns during FEDFUNDS declines are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS above 155,000 indicates strengthening labor market participation, boosting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in PAYEMS increases above 155,000 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (demand) and PAYEMS (labor) above their 12-month averages creates a dual expansion signal, driving equity valuations higher and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 20-day returns in dual expansion are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 302.0 signals accelerating inflation expectations, prompting market concerns about rate hikes and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL increases above 302.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
